name: Codewhale Launcher
description:
Start and resume Codewhale sessions straight from the top bar.

• New session via directory picker, opened in a Ptyxis terminal
• The five most recent sessions one click away
• Full history window (GTK4/libadwaita): search, resume, hide or permanently delete sessions
• Provider account balance in the panel (currently DeepSeek) with color-coded warning thresholds
• Approximate usage costs for today and the last 7 days, read from the local session store
• Translated into 11 languages, following the system locale

The balance is fetched from the provider's balance API; the API key is obtained via the Codewhale CLI and never stored or displayed. Cost figures are approximations — see the README for details.

Requires the codewhale CLI, Python ≥ 3.11, Ptyxis and zenity.
